description: Known self matches for the RevLens self scan. RevLens ships its own detection signatures (the yara-lite starter pack, capa-lite symbol lists, packer and obfuscator fingerprints), documentation that quotes those rules, and a deliberately suspicious demo sample. Scanning those files with the same signatures matches them by design. Each entry is narrow: one file pattern and the exact rules expected there. Any other rule on these files, and every rule on every other file, is still reported.

entries.reason: The analysis worker and the main bundle embed @revlens/core signature tables and the docs that describe each rule.
The Suspicious demo sample is assembled in the browser on purpose and contains eval(atob(...)). Its values are fake.

Since 1.0.0 the self scan also covers every published package. These three core files are the capa-lite symbol lists, the packer and obfuscator fingerprints and the yara-lite starter pack, so the same signatures match them by design. Other rules on these files, and all rules on other package files, are still reported.
